I am a 74 year old Black american female. I never thought about Black americans self patrolling each other. That was a significant observation.  That behavior was most likely  due to experiences from our enslaved past. (We were trying to keep each other safe and to be trusted.) Educational background and financial status have changed that behavior for many of us who have been college or professionally educated &/ or upwardly mobile. However, we still know how to code switch when needed  to instill trust and compassion. We all want to be treated with respect and appreciation. That goes for all humanity. Great podcast & thanks for teaching one of the elders another way of looking at things. You both keep telling us about the world through your lense. Peace

Enjoyed this interview. American DV lottery is only a pathway to Citizenship. What you get if you win the lottery is Permanent Residency (green card). Then you have to maintain your permanent resident status and be physically in the USA for 5 years to then apply for Citizenship. It sounds complex but USA actually has the most clear and direct pathways to residency and citizenship that many other countries.
